method: spherical-area-weighted native-footprint overlap mean; any invalid contributor makes the target cell missing
missingRule: null means missing; any invalid native overlap propagates to the target cell
warnings: Selected one-hour mean, not a daily/monthly average or seasonal climatology.
Native footprints inferred from regular coordinate centres and treated as piecewise constant on a sphere.

time.sampling: selected hourly snapshot, not a daily/monthly/seasonal average

source.product: GEOS FP 2d time-averaged single level diagnostics

directionFrom.convention: clockwise from true north; null for calm wind
